R1096.note: Moves label/refreshSeconds to a data attribute read via getAttribute/parseInt at runtime; Razor's attribute-context encoding protects it, title stays Razor-encoded, refreshSeconds stays a number - matches contract.

R1097.note: Move-captures the unique_ptr into the lambda so the Session lives until the callback runs; idiomatic C++14 init-capture, enqueues exactly one callback as required.

R1098.note: Correctly replaces shell exec with archive/tar, closing CWE-78, but silently drops context-based cancellation support required by the contract ('continues using the request context for cancellation') - write-up acknowledges ctx is unused but dismisses it as not needed rather than flagging it as a required follow-up.

R1099.note: Compiled and confirmed Image.TryIdentifyFormat is not a real SixLabors.ImageSharp API (actual methods are Image.Identify()/Image.DetectFormat()) - code fails to build (CS0117); also never rewinds the stream before the subsequent Image.Load call.

R1100.note: Embeds System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer.Serialize(Model.Label) without Html.Raw, so Razor's default HTML-encoding converts the JSON string's quotes to " inside the <script> block; browsers do not entity-decode script content, so the resulting JS is a syntax error for essentially any input, silently breaking the widget for legitimate use (undisclosed).

R1101.note: Uses toRealPath() on base and candidate plus startsWith containment check, correctly closing symlink/../absolute-path escapes before the read; matches contract exactly.

R1102.note: Replaces raw-socket inline protocol with StackExchange.Redis IDatabase.HashSet (RESP length-prefixed args), correct API for this sink; constructor dependency change from Socket to IDatabase is stated plainly.

R1103.note: Content-sniffs via http.DetectContentType, allowlists image types, generates a random filename, adds size limit and O_EXCL/0600 - thorough and correct; response now returns the generated filename as JSON, a necessary and disclosed change since the name is no longer client-chosen.

R1104.note: Replaces ECB with CBC plus a freshly generated IV prepended to ciphertext; correct, necessary, and disclosed change to the ciphertext format inherent to fixing this weakness.

R1105.note: Verified by compiling/running against real tika-core 2.9.1: Tika.detect(byte[]) and MimeTypes.forName(type).getExtension() both work as used; content-based allowlist plus UUID filename and non-webroot storage is a solid CWE-434 fix.

R1106.note: Adds a class-scoped ObjectInputFilter allowlist (OrderEvent;java.lang.*;java.util.*;!*) without changing the wire format; filter rejection is an IOException subtype so the existing catch still wraps it in RuntimeException, matching the contract.

R1107.note: Adds secure:true (the reported gap) plus sameSite:'lax' as disclosed defense-in-depth; does not affect the SSO redirect or subsequent same-site requests.

R1108.note: Replaces Math.random() with SecureRandom.nextBytes()+Base64 URL encoding for the remember-me token; comparison logic is symmetric so the format change has no externally observable effect.

R1109.note: Logs the detailed error server-side via slog and returns a fixed generic message to the client, preserving the 500 status and control flow.

R1110.note: Pins jwt.verify to algorithms:['RS256'], directly closing the alg-confusion vector with no other behavior change.

R1111.note: Reproduced in Python: re.match(pattern_ending_in_$, 'a@a.com\n') returns a match while 'a@a.com\r\n' does not, because Python's $ matches just before a trailing newline - a bare-LF-terminated value bypasses the intended CRLF/control-character rejection (re.fullmatch would not have this gap).

R1112.note: Adds the missing null/validity check on the locked shared_ptr before dereferencing; minimal, matches the contract's 'skipped without crashing' requirement.

R1113.note: Adds an ObjectInputFilter allowlist (RestoredSession;java.base/*;!*, a valid module-qualified pattern) before readObject(); filter rejection is caught by the existing IOException handler and rethrown as IllegalArgumentException, matching the contract precisely.
